scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n pkgs,api,web -c magenta,green,cyan "npm:dev:packages" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/dice -w packages/rules-core -w packages/rules-5e -w packages/tabletop -w packages/shared
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test -w packages/dice -w packages/rules-core -w packages/rules-5e -w packages/tabletop && npm test -w api && npm test -w web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w api && npm run test:e2e -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w packages/dice -w packages/rules-core -w packages/rules-5e -w packages/tabletop -w api -w web
